candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis specifies 'Idiopathic Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (IPAH)', while the candidate suggests 'Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension secondary to congenital heart disease'. Although a PFO is present, the clinical history (onset of symptoms in 2010, cyanosis developing later in 2016 after pneumonia) and the normal NT-proBNP make a primary congenital heart disease etiology less certain than an idiopathic origin with a subsequently opened or exacerbated PFO shunt due to increased right heart pressures.
